items.title: Alcide "Slow Drag" Pavageau Interview, 1958-12-10
items.q: He was a brother by Chukka.

ctx.x: Well that's who it was, wasn't it George? I guess. I was trying to find out. Yeah. What was it in George? And now who was in the Golden Rule? Adolph and Boo Boo.

What did Adolph? Adolph was playing cornet. He was a shoemaker, playing cornet, he was playing trumpet. And Boo Boo was playing slide, playing tramborne, very tramborne. That time they didn't use a slide tramborne again now. And they had this father called, let me just play guitar, I believe it was, not going to San Diego, no, it was, it had been some long, you know. I think it was Ramon Quay. Ramon? Ramon Quay. No, you don't know him. He wasn't born yet. I was about 17, 16, 17 years old, talking about something.…
Back to this golden rule, this Adolph who played cornet, did he have a son who played or anything?
